scene: 5-6 before battle — complete first literary draft (54 named; no bare)
editorial_notes: CN primary for meaning; EN for official names and structure. Source blob hashes recorded.
CN 大古广场 (Dagu Plaza) is officially named Paci Plaza in EN; Russian draft uses «Паси-Плаза» consistently.
CN officer answers 'Yes sir' in English, EN adapts to 'Yes ma'am'; RU uses neutral «Есть!» to avoid an unsupported gender/title choice.
CN specifies a rope descent from the top floor, which is retained instead of EN's shortened description.
CN says the attackers emerge from upper floors, not necessarily the roof; Russian keeps «с верхних этажей».
CN has censored Ursus and Lungmen expletives; their nature is indicated without inventing profanity.
No complete CN/EN script redistributed; preview is not a verified client patch.
